subject: [PATCH 13/60] mm/compaction: restrict compaction to common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts compaction to common memory nodes, improving performance and reducing unnecessary work on memoryless nodes. The changes affect the kcompactd daemon's initialization, proactive compaction triggers, and direct compaction mechanisms. By limiting compaction to common nodes, the patch aims to optimize resource utilization and reduce overhead.
